record.question: A starts business with Rs.3500 and after 5 months; B joins A as his partner. After a year the profit is divided in the ratio 2 : 3. What was B's contribution in the capital?
record.explanation: Answer B: Rs.9000. Profit shares are proportional to capital multiplied by investment time. A invests 3500 for 12 months; B invests x for 7 months. Thus 3500×12 : 7 x = 2 : 3, so 14 x = 126000 and x = Rs.9000. Only option B matches. Historical/source note: Assumes the usual partnership rule of constant invested capital and profit proportional to capital-time. This numerical item was included in the assigned GS/GK queue. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
